description: The door model (Features WV2, P6.core; catalog interiors-building-entry): a building's front door, its state, the prompt, and the handoff enter interior X / exit to Y that an engine turns into its scene change. Interiors are stated by pipelines/atelier (BuildingIR.interior), never invented: a building that states none has a no_interior door that never opens. Ops: door {building} -> {door}; prompt {buildings, player: {position, inside?}} -> {prompt}; session {buildings, inside?, playerItemIds?, steps: [{op: enter, building} | {op: exit} | {op: prompt, position}]} -> {steps: [{result, inside} | {prompt}]}. Every case is {name, op, input, expected}; numbers compare within tolerance, everything else exactly, object key sets included (a key TypeScript leaves undefined is absent). Runner: src/props/props-corpus.ts. Regenerate with npm run props-corpora; npm run props-corpora:check fails on any difference.
sources: babylon origin/main bfcdeb2: packages/babylon/src/engine/game-engine/rendering/BuildingEntrySystem.ts (804 lines): the front-face door, the 0.5 m stand-off, DOOR_PROXIMITY_RADIUS 2.0 on the ground plane, the nearest door, the label, the exit facing outward.
godot origin/main 6599874: templates/scripts/systems/building_entry_system.gd (798 lines): the same front-centre door.

pipelines origin/main 5328ed2: pipelines/game-export/ir-generator.ts states an interior by a content-keyed rule (pipelines/generators/interior-generator.ts: when any exported text is found at a cafe or restaurant, each settlement's eating house gets one, laid out by core's lay_interior; its eating houses are a Restaurant, Cafe, Tavern or Inn for a text at a cafe or restaurant, and since pipelines origin/main 55985db a Bar for a text at a cafe only, preferred last) and interior: null on every other building. On Brightwater it picks Denham's Tavern alone; pipelines' conformance/props-doors/brightwater-interiors.json replays that export's doors through this file's runner and contract.

core src/generation/primitives.ts lay_interior (the interior frame: origin at the minimum corner, width less two walls along x, depth less two walls along z, the entrance on the entry room's z = 0 edge at floor 0) and the door-warp convention (editor/scene/placement.ts: the interior is its own node at the origin).

core BuildingIR, InteriorLayoutIR, InteriorDoorIR (ir-types.ts); editor/layout/building-fit.ts doorWorld and doorHeading (the measured door point and facing a host passes as door and doorYaw = pi/2 - doorHeading; the Unreal plugin's DoorWorldYawDegrees, which InsimulSceneSpawn orients its door socket by).

contract.doorPoint: door (the layout's measured point) when given, else position + (sin r, cos r) * depth / 2; numbers rounded to 1e-9
contract.facing: the door's outward yaw f (it faces world (sin f, cos f), like rotation): doorYaw when a finite number (from building-fit: pi/2 - doorHeading, whose heading points along (cos h, sin h)); else, when door is given, the footprint face nearest it; else r. Nearest face: along = dx sin r + dz cos r, across = dx cos r - dz sin r (d = door - position); halfAlong = depth / 2, halfAcross = width / 2 (a missing or non-positive one takes the other, both missing 1); |across| / halfAcross > |along| / halfAlong picks right (across > 0, r + pi/2) or left (r - pi/2), else back (along < 0, r + pi) or front (r)
contract.outside: doorPoint + (sin f, cos f) * standoffM, yaw f (rounded to 1e-9): the player stands outside the door's own face, facing out through it
contract.state: no interior stated (null or absent) -> no_interior; else locked when the host says so; else closed
contract.label: name, else businessType, else spec.buildingRole, else Building (first non-empty)
contract.prompt: inside: exit for the building the player is in (null if unlisted); outside: the nearest door not no_interior with ground-plane distance strictly < promptRadiusM, the first listed on a tie
contract.enter: refusals in order: missing_field building, already_inside, unknown_building, no_interior, locked (without keyItemId held); else enter_interior {building, interior: interior:<id>, interiorFunction, arrive: the first entrance door's position (interior frame) or null when none is listed, entrance, unlocked}
contract.exit: not_inside, unknown_building; else exit_to_exterior {building, arrive: outside, yaw}
contract.interiorFrame: enter's arrive is the entrance door's position exactly as the interior states it, in the interior's own frame (InteriorLayoutIR: metres, origin at its minimum corner, x across its width, z along its depth, y the base of the door's floor; the front wall, the one the entrance is on, is z = 0, and +z runs from the front toward the back). Neither the building's position nor its rotation is applied: the interior is its own scene (the door-warp convention). exit's arrive and yaw are in the world frame. A ContainerIR at location interior keeps its world-frame position; the door model never reads it

door: turned a quarter, the door faces world +X
door: a building that states no interior is no_interior
door: a host-locked door is locked
door: the layout's measured door point wins over the front-centre rule
door: a measured door on the back face exits outside it, facing out (its doorYaw)
door: a measured door on a side face exits outside it, facing out (its doorYaw)
door: doorYaw wins over the face the door point is nearest
door: with no doorYaw, a measured back door faces out through the back face
door: with no doorYaw, a measured door on the left face of a turned building faces out through it
door: with no doorYaw, the face is chosen against each half-extent (width 6, depth 8)
door: a doorYaw that is not a number is ignored, and no door point is the front rule
door: the label falls back to the business type, the role, then Building
door: the business type labels a door with no name
prompt: the nearest door strictly within 2 m prompts enter
prompt: exactly 2 m away does not prompt
prompt: height is ignored (ground plane)
prompt: a no_interior door never prompts
prompt: a locked door prompts, with its state
prompt: on a tie the first listed wins

session: refusals: unknown action, no building, unknown building, exit while outside
